questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the below equation mathematically correct?

108 ÷ 27 × 54 – 40 + 34 = 48
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f17fe402f98bb01e6c434026861e42229a2db5fdddb9ac339c012f7a2b73afa8.png] 

Given:

⇒ 108 ÷ 27 × 54 – 40 + 34 = 48

(1) **– and +**

⇒ 108 ÷ 27 × 54 – 40 + 34 = 48

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 108 ÷ 27 × 54 – 40 + 34 = 48

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**108 ÷ 27**__ × 54 + 40 - 34

⇒ __**4 × 54**__ + 40 - 34

⇒ 216 + 40 - 34

⇒ 256 - 34 = 222

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(2) **÷ and ×**

⇒ 108 ÷ 27 × 54 – 40 + 34 = 48

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 108 × __**27 ÷ 54 **__– 40 + 34 = 48

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**108 × 0.5**__ - 40 + 34

⇒ 54 - 40 + 34

⇒ 88 - 40 = **48**

⇒ LHS = RHS

⇒ '108 × 27 ÷ 54 – 40 + 34 = 48'

Here, the equation is **satisfied.**

(3) **× and –**

⇒ 108 ÷ 27 × 54 – 40 + 34 = 48

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ __**108 ÷ 27**__ × 54 – 40 + 34 = 48

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 108 ÷ 27 - 54 × 40 + 34

⇒ 4 - 54 × 40 + 34

⇒ 4 - 2160 + 34

⇒ 38 - 2160 = (-2122)

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(4) **÷ and –**

⇒ 108 ÷ 27 × 54 – 40 + 34 = 48

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 108 - 27 × __**54 ÷ 40**__ + 34 = 48

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 108 - 27 × 1.35 + 34

⇒ 108 - 36.45 + 34

⇒ 142 - 36.45 = 105.55

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

Hence, the correct answer is "**÷ and ×**".

questions.question: In ancient times the area to the south of the_____ river was known as Magadha.

__
 
• **Magadha**:-

 
 
• **It was a powerful kingdom in ancient India, located in what is now the state of Bihar.**
 
• It was the birthplace of Buddhism and Jainism, and it played an important role in the development of Indian culture and civilization.
 
• **Magadha was known for its fertile soil, its strategic location on the Ganges River, and its rich mineral resources. **
 
• These factors contributed to its rise as a major power in ancient India. 
 
• **Magadha reached its peak under the Mauryan dynasty (322-184 BCE), which ruled over most of the Indian subcontinent.**
 
• The Mauryan Empire was one of the largest and most powerful empires in the ancient world.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ganga:-**

 
 
• **It is the largest and most sacred river in India. **
 
• It flows for over 2,500 km through the states of Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal, and Odisha.
 
• The Ganga is revered by Hindus and is considered to be a holy river.
 
 
 
• **Yamuna:-**
 
 
• The Yamuna River is the **largest tributary of the Ganga.**
 
• It flows for approximately 1,376 km through **Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Haryana, Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, and Rajasthan.**

questions.question: In an election between two candidates, 10% of the voters did not vote and 150 votes were declared invalid. The winner got 350 votes more than his opponent, thus he got 50% of the total voters registered in the voter list. The percentage of votes of the defeated candidate out of the total registered votes is ________. (count up to one place after the decimal)
questions.solution:
Given:

Percentage of candidates did not votes = 10%

Invalid votes = 150

A got votes more than B = 350

Percentage of A secured the total voters on the voter list = 50%

Calculation:

Let total voters on the voter list = x

A got votes = x × (50/100)

B got votes = x × (50/100) – 350

x × (50/100) + x × (50/100) – 350 = x × (90/100) – 150

⇒ 0.50x + 0.50x – 350 = 0.90x - 150

⇒ x – 350 = 0.90x – 150

⇒ 0.10x = 350 – 150

⇒ 0.10x = 200

⇒ x = 200/0.10

⇒ x = 2000

Votes of the loser candidate = 0.50 × 2000 – 350 = 1000 - 350

⇒ 650

Percentage votes of the loser candidate

**Therefore, the percentage of votes of the defeated candidate out of the total registered votes is 32.5%.**

questions.question: Successive discounts of 10%,15% and 20% amount to a single discount of:
questions.solution:

First discount = 10%

Second discount = 15%

Third discount = 20%

**Concept Used:**

The formula for the equivalent single discount of successive discounts, which is 1 - (1 - d1)(1 - d2)(1 - d3), where d1, d2, d3 are the decimal equivalents of the discounts.

**Calculation:**

Convert the discounts to decimal form. 10% = 0.1, 15% = 0.15, 20% = 0.2.

The equivalent single discount = 1 - (1 - 0.1)(1 - 0.15)(1 - 0.2) = 1 - (0.9)(0.85)(0.8) = 1 - 0.612 = 0.388.

Percentage = 0.388 × 100% = 38.8%.

**Therefore, the equivalent single discount to 10%, 15%, and 20% is 38.8%.**
